name: Sysgration Ltd.
summary: Sysgration Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile electronics and power management products in Taiwan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It also provides internal and external BLE TPMS products; and energy bricks and container based solar energy storage systems. In addition, it offers battery pack products, such as power stations, EV battery packs, and UPS LIB packs; power devices comprising power conditioning system, MPPT charger, and charging station; grid-tied ESS, off-grid ESS, and battery cabinet and pack; and power supply and battery backup centralized solutions. Sysgration Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
